captures.description: THE CORPUS, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'Dolma is an open-source 3-trillion-token English corpus created by the Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence (Ai2) to support language model pretraining and transparency.' Access (Hugging Face, the GitHub toolkit); key features: scale ('version 1.7 utilizes about 1.715 trillion actual training tokens across ~5.2 billion documents totaling over 5,300 GB'), data sources by kind with their named sets, the curation pipeline ('Bloom filter deduplication (by URL, paragraph, and document), PII/toxicity masking'), licensing ('ODC-BY and Ai2's ImpACT license'), primary use (OLMo); two follow-up questions. Six cards: Hugging Face, the GitHub Pages documentation, Ai2, arXiv, Deep (Learning) Focus, ACL Anthology.
